personas.name: Ayesha Siddiqui
personas.goal: Keep the family's passports, bank accounts and school documents in one safe place
personas.headline: How Ayesha keeps her family's documents in one place
personas.summary: Ayesha runs a pharmacy shift and two school runs. She uses VaultCap's family profiles and expiry reminders so passports and school papers live in one encrypted vault instead of drawers and chat threads.

day.title: Morning check
day.text: She opens the vault home and sees three documents expiring this month — including her son's passport.
day.alt: Ayesha's vault home showing sample net worth and upcoming reminders

day.title: Documents
day.text: Between customers she pulls up scanned passports and school letters — search finds a file in seconds.
day.alt: Documents list with passport and school papers

day.title: Family vault
day.text: Her husband's profile stays separate but shared on the same phone — each person's records stay encrypted.
day.alt: Family profiles section for shared household vault

day.title: Ramadan planning
day.text: She glances at the Zakat summary from holdings in the sample vault before talking to her accountant.
day.alt: Zakat summary from holdings in the sample vault

video.transcript: Ayesha opens VaultCap, checks reminders, finds a passport scan, switches to her husband's family profile, then views the Zakat summary. All numbers and names are fictional sample data.

personas.name: Omar Farooq
personas.goal: Track multi-currency accounts and take an encrypted backup before changing phones
personas.headline: How Omar backs up before every phone upgrade
personas.summary: Omar freelances across AED, GBP and PKR accounts. He lists banks in VaultCap, then exports an encrypted backup to Files before he swaps phones — no more lost IBAN notes.

day.title: Bank list
day.text: He reviews AED, GBP and PKR accounts in one scroll — favourites pin the accounts he checks daily.
day.alt: Omar's multi-currency bank list in the sample vault

day.title: Dashboard
day.text: Net worth rolls up in one dashboard so he knows whether to move cash before a client pays late.
day.alt: Dashboard with AED GBP and PKR balances summarised

day.title: Encrypted backup
day.text: Before a new iPhone arrives he exports a .vos backup to Files — restore is a guided flow on the next device.
day.alt: Encrypted backup screen before a phone change

day.title: Security check
day.text: He confirms PIN and encryption settings — the vault never leaves the device unless he chooses to export.

video.transcript: Omar opens banks, checks the dashboard, creates an encrypted backup, and reviews security. Illustrative balances only.

personas.name: Margaret Ellis
personas.goal: One place for pension and insurance documents her son can help with
personas.headline: How Margaret keeps pension papers readable
personas.summary: Margaret retired from teaching and uses larger text in VaultCap. Insurance and pension PDFs sit in one documents list; her son helps via a local family profile when she visits.

day.title: Home at large text
day.text: She opens the vault with text large enough to read without glasses — reminders show policy renewals clearly.
day.alt: Margaret's vault home at larger text size on iPhone SE

day.title: Documents
day.text: Pension letters and insurance schedules are tagged — search beats hunting through folders in two rooms.
day.alt: Documents list with pension and insurance files

day.title: Son helps locally
day.text: When her son visits he switches to his family profile on the same phone — nothing is uploaded to a server.
day.alt: Family profile shared locally with her son

day.title: Renewal reminder
day.text: A reminder nudges her two weeks before home insurance renews — she sets a note for the call centre.
day.alt: Reminders showing an insurance renewal coming up

video.transcript: Margaret opens the vault at large text, finds documents, shows her son the family profile, and checks a renewal reminder. Fictional policy names throughout.

personas.quote: The writing is big enough. My son can find it too.
